qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Strong consumer paint brands (Dulux) and industrial coatings formulations, but compromised by lack of captive store distribution. Distribution through independent DIY big-box retailers exposes Akzo to channel bargaining power and raw material inflation (TiO2), resulting in a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 10.95% (< 12%).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Akzo Nobel possesses recognizable decorative paint brands (Dulux, Sikkens), but lacks the captive direct-to-pro store network that underpins Sherwin-Williams' pricing power. Sells primarily through third-party DIY retailers and wholesale merchants, leaving margins exposed to raw material cycles (titanium dioxide) and resulting in a sub-hurdle 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 10.95%.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 10.95% (2022: 7.6%, 2023: 10.3%, 2024: 11.6%, 2025: 12.3%) fails the 12% hurdle. Exposure to European retail channels and fierce competition from PPG and Axalta limits immediate pricing pass-through during input cost surges.
